summary: Conditional scalar density cap <=1 plus two-dimensional marginal density cap <=1 and fixed |det G|=1 do not uniformly bound a nonzero-pivot indefinite quadratic. For G_a=[[a,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]], an explicit dependent law with both caps one has Q_a supported on an interval of length 3a/4, hence ||p_Qa||_infinity>=4/(3a). This is not a QFORM counterexample because the constructed dependent law is not asserted to arise from the required product/projection source. The punctured near-coloop proof must retain stronger original-product provenance.
